summary: Soccer jumping header at contact: airborne after a one-foot takeoff, ball on the forehead, trunk snapping forward, elbows out for balance.

cameras.name: side_low
cameras.text: Profile: forehead meeting the ball, neck and trunk in one line.

cameras.name: front_low
cameras.text: Low angle from in front, sky or stadium roof behind, ball in sharp focus.

cameras.name: wide_cinema
cameras.text: Wide frame from behind the header toward the goal.

rules.why: head, neck and trunk aligned, chin not tipped back
trunk snapping forward into the ball
arms out for balance and space

text.action: a soccer player rising for a jumping header, the ball meeting the forehead
text.core: Airborne after a one-foot takeoff, left leg hanging nearly straight with toes pointed, right knee bent and lifted; trunk snapping forward from the hips; head, neck and trunk locked in one line; forehead (hairline) meeting the back of the ball; eyes open; both elbows raised out to the sides at shoulder height.
text.gaze: Eyes open and on the ball, mouth closed.
cues: contact with the forehead, not the top of the head
keep head, neck and torso aligned
arch then snap the trunk forward
arms out for balance and to hold space
kinetic: ball compressing against the forehead, water spray flying off the ball
hair flicked forward by the impact
defender's shadow on the grass below
avoid: ball on the top of the head or the face
